news.title: NVIDIA Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Vera Rubin Ramp
news.summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) stock trades near $225, about 28.3 times its adjusted earnings over the past twelve months. Adjusted here means normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, the same broad basis analysts use in their forecasts. For a stock near its 52-week high, that looks steep. But the multiple leaves out the growth analysts already expect, and that growth depends on how much NVIDIA can supply.
news.title_zh: NVIDIA 股票看起來昂貴，直到你考慮 Vera Rubin 的增長
news.summary_zh: NVIDIA (NVDA) 股票價格接近 $225，約為其過去十二個月調整後的每股收益的 28.3 倍。調整後的每股收益是指在分析師預測中使用的淨收入正常化後加回股票薪酬。對於一隻接近 52 周高點的股票來說，這看起來很高。但這個倍數沒有考慮到分析師已經預期的增長，而這種增長取決於 NVIDIA 能供應多少。
